# Effects

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## add_counters

Put `amount` counters named `counter` on each referenced permanent. Any counter name works (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty, stun, shield, oil, a keyword, ...); see docs/reference/counters.md for the ones with rules.

Rules: CR 122.1, CR 122.6, CR 613.4c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | counter name (+X/+Y, -X/-Y or a lowercase word) |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## add_mana

You add mana to your mana pool: the fixed mana in `produce`, or `amount` mana of a color you choose as it resolves (`color: "any_one"`: all of one color; `color: "any"`: each mana's color chosen separately, "in any combination of colors").

Rules: CR 106.1a, CR 106.4, CR 608.2d, CR 605.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `produce` | mana symbols, e.g. "{R}{R}" |
| `amount` | amount (with color; default 1) |
| `color` | any_one | any |

```json
{
  "add_mana": {
    "amount": 2,
    "color": "any_one"
  }
}
```

## assimilate

Assimilate each referenced permanent or permanent card: you gain control of it (or put it onto the battlefield under your control) with a +1/+1 counter, and it becomes a Borg artifact creature while it stays on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 701.72a, CR 701.72b, CR 205.1b, CR 613.1b, CR 613.1d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (permanents, or a target card in a graveyard) |

```json
{
  "assimilate": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## attach

Attach this Aura or Equipment (the ability's source) to the referenced permanent. Nothing happens if it can't legally be attached to it, if it's already attached to it, or if the source has left the battlefield.

Rules: CR 701.3a, CR 701.3b, CR 701.3c, CR 301.5c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (a single target) |

```json
{
  "attach": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## choose_cards

You choose `count` (default 1; "any": any number) cards matching `for` from `from`: a selector (e.g. {"result": 0}, the cards an earlier effect milled) or a player's zone, {"hand": selector} / {"graveyard": selector}. `optional`: you may choose fewer. Then they are put into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield, under your control; exiled cards `link`ed to the source). `look`: you look at the whole zone first; `reveal`: "chosen" reveals what you chose, "all" the whole set. `then` runs if a card was chosen, `otherwise` if none was ("if you can't").

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 701.20e, CR 400.7j, CR 608.2c, CR 607.2a, CR 118.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `from` | selector or {"hand"|"graveyard": player selector} |
| `for` | card spec |
| `count` | integer or "any" |
| `optional` | boolean |
| `put` | hand | graveyard | exile | battlefield | library_top | library_bottom |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `link` | boolean |
| `look` | boolean |
| `reveal` | chosen | all |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "choose_cards": {
    "from": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "for": {
      "permanent": true
    },
    "optional": true,
    "put": "hand"
  }
}
```

## create_token

Create `amount` tokens under the referenced player's control (default: you). `token` is a predefined token name (Treasure, Clue, Food) or an inline card definition. `tapped: true` creates them tapped.

Rules: CR 111.1, CR 111.10, CR 701.7a, CR 704.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | "Treasure" | "Clue" | "Food" | {card data} |
| `amount` | integer (default 1) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `to` | selector (default "you") |

```json
{
  "create_token": {
    "token": {
      "name": "Soldier",
      "types": [
        "creature"
      ],
      "subtypes": [
        "soldier"
      ],
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## deal_damage

Deal `amount` damage to each referenced creature, planeswalker or player. Damage to a player causes life loss; to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters; to a creature is marked until cleanup.

Rules: CR 120.3a, CR 120.3c, CR 120.3e, CR 120.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "deal_damage": {
    "amount": 3,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## delayed_trigger

Creates a delayed triggered ability with the controller and source of the resolving spell or ability. It triggers only once, the next time `when` happens (e.g. {"step_begins": {"step": "end", "whose": "each"}} for the next end step). Its `effects` may use {"result": n} for what earlier effects of the creating list moved or created; those objects are affected only if they are still where they were put.

Rules: CR 603.7a, CR 603.7b, CR 603.7c, CR 603.7d, CR 603.7e

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `when` | a trigger condition |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "delayed_trigger": {
    "when": {
      "step_begins": {
        "step": "end",
        "whose": "each"
      }
    },
    "effects": [
      {
        "sacrifice": {
          "to": {
            "result": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## dig

Look at the top `amount` cards of your library (`reveal: "all"`: reveal them). Take `count` (default 1; "all": every matching card, no choice) cards matching `for` and put them into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield); `optional`: you may take fewer. `reveal: "chosen"` reveals the cards taken. The rest go to `rest`: "bottom_random" (default), "bottom_any" (in an order you choose) or "graveyard".

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 701.20e, CR 401.4, CR 400.7j

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount (how many cards) |
| `for` | card spec (default any card) |
| `count` | integer or "all" |
| `optional` | boolean |
| `put` | hand | battlefield | graveyard |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `reveal` | none | chosen | all |
| `rest` | bottom_random | bottom_any | graveyard |

```json
{
  "dig": {
    "amount": 6,
    "for": {
      "types": [
        "artifact"
      ]
    },
    "optional": true,
    "reveal": "chosen",
    "put": "hand"
  }
}
```

## exile

Exile each referenced permanent, or card in a graveyard or hand. `link: true`: the cards are exiled with the source, for its "exiled with" abilities (the `exiled_with` selector). `until_source_leaves: true`: they return to the battlefield under their owners' control when the source leaves the battlefield; if it already has, nothing is exiled.

Rules: CR 406.1, CR 701.13a, CR 607.2a, CR 406.6, CR 610.3, CR 610.3a, CR 610.3b, CR 610.3c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |
| `link` | boolean |
| `until_source_leaves` | boolean |

```json
{
  "exile": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## exile_top

Each referenced player (default: you) exiles the top `amount` cards of their library (face up). Later effects name them with {"result": n}; `link: true` exiles them with the source.

Rules: CR 406.1, CR 400.7j, CR 607.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount |
| `to` | selector of players |
| `link` | boolean |

```json
{
  "exile_top": {
    "amount": 4
  }
}
```

## may

An optional effect. The controller chooses yes or no as it resolves; yes is offered only if every effect in `effects` can be done fully. On yes, `effects` then `then` ("if you do") happen; on no, `otherwise` ("if you don't"). Nested effects may name the results of earlier effects of the enclosing list.

Rules: CR 118.12, CR 118.3, CR 608.2d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `effects` | list of effects (the optional part) |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "may": {
    "effects": [
      {
        "discard": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ],
    "then": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## return_to_battlefield

Put each referenced card that is in exile or a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control (`under: "you"`: under the controller's), tapped if `tapped: true`. A card that is no longer in the zone it was expected in, or isn't a permanent card, stays where it is.

Rules: CR 400.7, CR 400.4a, CR 110.2, CR 111.8, CR 603.7c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (usually {"result": n}) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `under` | owner | you |

```json
{
  "return_to_battlefield": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## reveal_until

Reveal cards from the top of your library until `count` (an amount, default 1) cards matching `for` are revealed (or the library runs out). Put those into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield, under your control) and the rest to `rest` (default the bottom in a random order).

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 401.4, CR 400.7j

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec |
| `count` | amount |
| `put` | hand | battlefield |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `rest` | bottom_random | bottom_any | graveyard |

```json
{
  "reveal_until": {
    "for": {
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "count": 2,
    "put": "battlefield",
    "tapped": true
  }
}
```

## sacrifice_choice

Each referenced player (default: you) sacrifices `count` (default 1; "any": any number) permanents they control matching `filter`, chosen by them in turn order starting with the active player; all are sacrificed at once. The `filter`'s `controller` and `other` restrictions are relative to the effect's controller and source.

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 101.4, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | a filter, e.g. {"creature": {"token": false}} |
| `count` | integer or "any" |
| `to` | selector of players |

```json
{
  "sacrifice_choice": {
    "filter": "creature",
    "to": "each_opponent"
  }
}
```

## search_library

Search your library for up to `count` cards matching `for`, then put them into your hand (or onto the battlefield, tapped if `tapped`, with `counters`) and shuffle. With a stated quality you may find fewer (or none); a search for just "a card" must find one if it can. `reveal` shows the found cards to every player. `searcher` names another player who searches their own library (e.g. {"controller_of": {"target": 0}}); `may: true` lets the searcher decline (then nothing is shuffled).

Rules: CR 701.23a, CR 701.23b, CR 701.23d, CR 701.23e, CR 701.20a, CR 701.24a, CR 701.24b, CR 118.12, CR 110.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec: "card" (default), {"types"|"subtypes"|"supertypes": [...], "name": "..."} or {"any_of": [spec, ...]} |
| `count` | integer (default 1), "any" (any number) or an amount ("up to that many") |
| `put` | "hand" (default) or "battlefield" |
| `tapped` | true: the cards enter tapped (with put: battlefield) |
| `counters` | {counter name: n}: the cards enter with these counters (with put: battlefield) |
| `reveal` | true: reveal the found cards |
| `searcher` | selector of the searching player (default "you") |
| `may` | true: the searcher may choose not to search |

```json
{
  "search_library": {
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "reveal": true
  }
}
```
